terra.problem: Saying Jesus was waiting on shore adds a detail the passage does not give. He dismisses the crowd and goes up the mountain to pray.
The passage gives the wind as the reason for their straining, but it does not say whether the boat had a leak.
Saying the oars were doing their job adds a detail about their condition that the passage does not give.
Saying Jesus spoke at once so they would not have to sit in fear assigns a purpose the text does not state.
Jesus also tells them to take courage, so He does tell them to do something besides not be afraid.
The text says the wind died down, not that it stopped.
The oven calming down when its door is opened is not a clear comparison to the wind dying down.
The feeding of the crowd is outside this passage and needs its own reference. The oven joke also brings bread into a joke rather than mentioning it only as a Bible fact.
The bakery-sign joke does not clearly match the people recognizing Jesus. It is unclear what the people passing the sign are supposed to recognize.
The passage does not establish that the feeding and the carrying of the sick happened on the same day. A night passes between them.
The passage does not say whether anyone went to the shore for the boat. It says what they asked to touch.
